detailZones.title: Counter workstation
detailZones.description: A desktop monitor, keyboard and telephone stand in front of the terminal window, beside a potted plant.

detailZones.title: Forms and stationery
detailZones.description: One form lies in a tray and another is clipped to a board. A pen, a black ring binder and a tape dispenser share the writing ledge.

detailZones.title: Tags and service bell
detailZones.description: Blank luggage tags and a stack of paper slips stand in clear holders beside a suitcase pictogram, a receipt printer and a silver service bell.

detailZones.title: Upright soft suitcase
detailZones.description: A burgundy wheeled suitcase stands on the floor in front of the curved wooden counter, with an extended handle and a zipped front pocket.

detailZones.title: Tagged bags on the rack
detailZones.description: A dark blue holdall and a gray bag rest on two wire shelves. Both have handles and blank hanging tags.

detailZones.title: Open suitcase and clothes
detailZones.description: A turquoise suitcase holds folded clothes beneath crossed straps. Its open lid has a gray zipped mesh pocket.

detailZones.title: Counter and furniture
detailZones.description: The curved counter has vertical wood grain on its front. The packing table has a pale wooden top and square metal legs.

anchorAudit.rationale: Each point selects a visible object, component or directly observable feature of the service counter, luggage or packing table. Baggage status, documents' contents and ownership are recorded only as related vocabulary.
